ben_cs: Cobalt onboarding hitting intermittent HTTP/2 connection resets + 429s during SDK init. They see a lot of failures right after deploy. Anyone seen similar?
marta_eng: Can you paste the console / gateway logs?
ben_cs: From their browser console: `Error: stream error: stream ID 13; RST_STREAM (11)`
ben_cs: On the gateway we see `HTTP/2 429 for /v1/preflight` and a bunch of `GOAWAY` entries right after client bursts.
sam_sdk: RST_STREAM 11 usually server-side killing streams under pressure. How many parallel inits are they doing?
ben_cs: Customer reports ~60-90 SDK instances firing preflight/token fetch at page load (SPA).
ira_infra: That sounds like a concurrency flood. Our edge defaults h2.max_concurrent_streams per connection is 100 but we also have an active stream-shedding policy that issues GOAWAY when CPU or mem thresholds spike.
sam_sdk: For browser SDKs we should consolidate token fetches and preflight. We can add a short coalescing window (50-100ms) so multiple instances share one preflight.
marta_eng: Repro steps?
ben_cs: Local repro I ran: `for i in {1..80}; do node sdk_init_sim.js & done` -> ~25% of runs returned RST_STREAM, ~10% got 429.
ira_infra: Quick infra mitigation: I can bump h2.max_concurrent_streams to 250 for the onboarding edge pool for 30m while we validate. Do you want me to?
ben_cs: Please, do it for pool-6. Customer is in eu-west-1.
ira_infra: Done: increased to 250 for pool-6, TTL 30m. Watching metrics.
sam_sdk: I'll prepare an SDK patch to coalesce preflight + shared ephemeral token for SPA usage. Workaround for customers until patch: set `sdkConfig.maxConcurrentInit = 6` and `sdkConfig.coalescePreflight = true` if they can opt in.
marta_eng: Added a short blurb to the onboarding playbook and the external quickstart: "If you see many 429s/resets on first load, reduce parallel init or enable shared token/coalescing."
ben_cs: Customer tested after infra change and saw errors drop from ~30% -> ~3%. They're happy to try SDK change once canary is up.
sam_sdk: Pushing canary patch to coalesce preflight (small change). Will ping here when canary finishes.
deploy-bot: Deployment started -> service(sdkgateway): canary-2026-03-21-009, sha=abc123
sam_sdk: Canary looks good on canary-1 (no regressions, preflight coalescing firing). Rolling to canary-2.
ben_cs: Shared patch + infra bump resolved the onboarding pain. I'll check back with Cobalt in 24h and close the loop. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
